    Products of vertices, arrows and words in a path algebra #

    The relations of kQ as equations: e_v e_w = δ_{vw} e_v, a e_v = δ_{v, s(a)} a, e_v a = δ_{v, t(a)} a, a word of a nonempty path ending at y is fixed by e_y on the left, and word (l ++ [a]) = a · word l.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.vertex_mul_vertex (k : Type u) [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (v w : Q.V) :
    vertex k Q v * vertex k Q w = if v = w then vertex k Q v else 0
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.arrow_mul_src (k : Type u) [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (a : Q.A) :
    arrow k Q a * vertex k Q (Q.src a) = arrow k Q a
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.tgt_mul_arrow (k : Type u) [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (a : Q.A) :
    vertex k Q (Q.tgt a) * arrow k Q a = arrow k Q a

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.arrow_mul_vertex (k : Type u) [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (a : Q.A) (v : Q.V) :
    arrow k Q a * vertex k Q v = if v = Q.src a then arrow k Q a else 0

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.vertex_mul_arrow (k : Type u) [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (v : Q.V) (a : Q.A) :

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.word_append_arrow (k : Type u) [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (a : Q.A) (l : List Q.A) :
    word k Q (l ++ [a]) = arrow k Q a * word k Q l

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.FinQuiver.vertex_mul_word (k : Type u) [Field k] {Q : FinQuiver} (c : Q.A) (l : List Q.A) (x y : Q.V) :
    PathFrom x (c :: l) y → vertex k Q y * word k Q (c :: l) = word k Q (c :: l)
